selector.rationale: The patient has a trace positive MTB on GeneXpert and subsequently grew MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid, along with bilateral reticular-nodular opacities on chest radiograph, which strongly supports pulmonary tuberculosis. Additionally, the presence of contiguous spondylitis and a painful nonhealing ulcer with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation also suggests extrapulmonary manifestations of tuberculosis, such as Pott's disease.
